commits.message: fix(apply): an answer asks for the click error's mark only until one has carried it; a render's throw is the daemon's unless the close refused it (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.1ql)
fix(apply): the answered mark's line names its own verb; comments say what an in-turn gather lets a draw read (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.1ql)

fix(apply): a render refused at its turn names its session and logs as the close; one rule says what an unanswered event's refusal is (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.1ql)

- The render edge notes the session first on the request's line, so a request
  the close refused at its turn still names it; the draw no longer notes it.
- A render's thrown error maps to its outcome as a click's does: the close is
  `closing` at info, not `threw` at error.
- The request arm reads the revision inside its own turn and notes its facts
  straight onto the line.
- The menu idle close says its refusal through the one rule the delivery edge
  and the performer use.
- The no-write test counts the store's persists, which an unfiltered batch
  bumps without moving the revision; a new case pins the close refusing a
  queued request.
- The arm's comment states that an in-turn gather holds every request; the fix
  that no turn awaits a launch is candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l.

feat(apply): a request takes its turn; its two writes are one batch in the request arm, and the answered mark is an event (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.1ql)

The request arm records what the client said (client-hints, render-origin)
as one setBatch inside a journal turn and draws once the turn is over, so a
request that arrives while a click's turn is held draws the click whole,
never its first write beside the request's hints. The turn waits behind
turns alone: a click's head gather holds none. The click error's answered
mark, the one other request-path write, is an `answered` event whose arm
takes a turn; the delivery edge applies it as the performer applies
effect-done, with a refusal said in the log.

The render line gains renderer=main, factsSeq, turnWait and revision; the
request's apply line stays null, since the render event is its one record.
The daemon's draw is a port on the request arm's parts, so the arm is
driven below the daemon. The daemon's adapters gain `sessionWrites`: the
production daemon writes the store, every daemon built in a worker writes
through the write-outside-turn instrument. A run's ending and a lane
setup's failure still write the store outside a turn (the next story).

Tests: test/request-turn.test.ts races a request against a click whose
doctor gathers inside its turn under a held clock, and against one parked
in its head gather; apply-effects covers the answered mark's turn. The
boot ratchet forbids a new in-worker case, so the race lives at the root
over Apply and the real journal turns.
docs(memory): a world path under the root is refused; an older build's bare path is read as this build spells it (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.f00.n2j)
fix(home): an older build's bare stored path reads as this build spells it, so an upgrade keeps its undo history (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.f00.n2j)
fix(home): a load answers only a refused stored path; the durable-config helper fails on a dropped history (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.f00.n2j)

feat(home): a stored path says whether it is the home's or the world's; a copied home undoes into its own config (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.f00.n2j)

A path a renderer stores is a StoredPath: a file under the home's root is the
home's, stored relative to it, and anything else is the world's, stored
absolute. Reading one back refuses an absolute path under the root, a home path
that climbs out, and a relative world path, naming it. The root is one
derivation of the home on DaemonPaths: a named home's root, main's config
directory.

The settings history's file changes and the render origin's configFile hold
the union on disk; in memory both stay resolved absolute paths. A history
naming a file its root refuses is dropped whole, with a warning naming the
session, the step and the path. The origin's configFile is the union itself or
null for a search, so an older build refuses the record loudly rather than
reading a named file as a search, and the record heals on the next render. The
client hints record drops configEnv, which nothing reads back: the origin is
the one record of the config a request named.

The two-homes test widens: one home names its config file, no file under
either root but the log names either root, and the first home's tree copied
under a third root undoes into the copy's config and leaves the original's
byte-equal.

fix(load-gate): the steady phase begins once the daemon has settled, and a wait with no time left takes no loop turn (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.09c) (#626)

* fix(load-gate): the steady phase begins once the daemon has settled, a wait with no time left takes no loop turn, and a failed render names what the daemon's log shows over it (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.09c)

The one failed render of run 42154313711 was not a GC pause: the daemon logged a line every 10-34 ms through the episode. It was a saturated loop while the speed lane was still landing for every session, 13 s into a steady phase that had begun before the daemon settled, and the failed request lost its last 54 ms to a 0 ms timer behind the poll phase. The gate now waits for every session's latest render to be answered inside its wait, at both points the steady phase must not inherit a backlog from; waitWithin with no time left aborts in the same turn; each steady failure carries the daemon's lines, longest silence and deadline draws over its round trip, and the facts carry the connect-to-wait spread.

* test(process): a render whose config read outlives the backstop answers its client in the turn the read ends; the memory line and the gate deadline comment say so (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.09c)

* fix(wait): a wait with no time left ends once the microtask queue drains, so held values still answer and a failing wait still fails the render; the gate's settle names how unsettled renders ended and stops on a dead daemon (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.09c)

The resume settle counts only renders logged after the collection ends, and a failure's longest silence is bounded by its window's edges, so a pause over the whole window no longer reads as zero. The backstop's and the render wait's comments say a render holding the loop past the backstop answers late in the turn it yields.

* fix(load-gate): a session settles on a render answered with time left and read by its client, read through the one logfmt reader; a failure's log window reaches the end of its round trip (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.09c)

A render set up past its deadline can now answer from held values, so answered alone no longer says the backlog drained. The memory line on the backstop states its guarantee only for a render held in a synchronous turn.

* fix(load-gate): a render the backstop answered first never settles a session, and the gate reads its stamped log in one place; the wait's comment and the held-clock memory line say what a wait with no time left does (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.09c)

## [1.196.0](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.195.0...v1.196.0) (2026-11-06)

### Features

* **facts:** a view follows its session through the Facts interface, with an in-process arm, a recording arm and the seam test (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.go2) ([#624](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/624)) ([a38c437](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/a38c437bf19653dbd6f983f06de25bc82f2d4a58))
test(facts): name the doctor's closure tests for what they protect (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.xb3)
fix(facts): the wait's comment names every session; the doctor's namespace-read test returns (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.xb3)

chore(facts): delete the wants closure (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.xb3)

The facts document is total, so the question "which fields does this config
read" has no caller with a reason. Every session now gathers every built-in:
git runs one constant option set (forge lookup included), every declared
plugin source is held, and burn, block and autocompact's context cap are always
composed. A view's declaration depends on the request alone, so a preset pick
moves no hold.

Deleted: the wants function, the needed-prefix builders, the sources-read walk,
the closure parameter through declare/refresh/read/project, the PR reads gate,
the git options derived from the closure, `Gathered`, `declaredSources`, and the
view's preset reaction. The doctor's data-needs walk stays and now owns its own
per-segment path closure, since it answers what a config would read.

The bar is byte-identical; the payload golden gains the keys that were gated
(block, burn, metrics, activity, tmux and the like on presets that did not read
them). Tests that asserted gating are deleted; the fold-edge cases they covered
(partials, helpers handed a dict) move to the doctor's path closure.
